title: The Last Dictionary entry
description: One dictionary entry, stored as data/entries/<id>.yaml. Generated from src/lib/schema.ts by `pnpm build:data`; do not edit by hand.

term.description: The headword, written as it is most often written.

id.description: URL slug and file name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Never changes once published.

sort_as.description: How to file the word alphabetically when that differs from the headword. People are filed by surname: 'Turing Alan'.

pos.description: Part of speech, abbreviated: n., v., adj., adv., abbr., phr., prop. n.

also.description: Other names, spellings and abbreviations. They appear in the A–Z and work in search.

pronunciation.description: A simple respelling, e.g. 'AY-star', when the reading is not obvious.

domain.description: The home domain. See data/taxonomy.yaml for codes.

labels.description: Usage labels for the whole entry: emerging, contested, legal, ...

level.description: essential (a newcomer needs it), core (working vocabulary) or specialist (research and niche terms).

dates.description: For people: life dates, e.g. '1912–1954' or 'b. 1977'.

plain.description: One or two sentences anyone can follow. The reader starts here.

context.description: The field or setting in which this sense applies, e.g. 'Interpretability'. Used when a word has several senses.

definition.description: The precise definition. May contain [[id|text]] cross-links to other entries and `code`.

example.description: One sentence using the word the way practitioners use it.

labels.description: Usage labels that apply to this sense only.

senses.description: The precise definitions, numbered when a word has several meanings.

formula_latex.description: A defining formula in LaTeX, rendered as MathML.

origin.description: Who introduced the word, when and where, stated only as firmly as the evidence allows. May contain cross-links.

year.description: First known use in this sense (or founding year for organizations). Places the word on the timeline.

note.description: Usage note: common confusions, disputes and advice. May contain cross-links.

see_also.description: Related entries, by headword or alias (not by id).

contrast.description: Opposites and easily confused neighbors, by headword or alias.

sources.description: Primary sources for the origin and the definition.

text.description: The citation as it should be read: authors, year, title, venue or publisher. Written fresh, not pasted from a reference manager.

url.description: A link to the source when one exists.

standards.description: Where a statute or standard defines the term: the instrument and article, paraphrased.

as_of.description: For time-sensitive entries, the month the facts were last checked, as YYYY-MM.
